newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers slip, most European ports weaker.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers slip, most European ports weaker.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices recovered from a weak start on Thursday but still ended the day about $1 lower as demand seen earlier this week faded, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted around $88-90 a tonne fob by the close after trading early on Thursday as low as $86.
"There was good demand on Tuesday and Wednesday but we've seen none of it today," said one supplier, pegging total ARA volumes at little more than 15,000 tonnes, 5-10,000 tonnes below average.
Hamburg bunkers also lost ground, shedding $2 on 380 CST and up to $4 a tonne for 180 CST.
Most southern European ports also saw lower prices, with the exception of Iraly's Augusta, where dealers reported steady activity.
Fujairah was stronger, however, helped by firmer prices in Singapore, dealers said.
Prices for 380 CST were pegged around $96 a tonne and $104 for 180 CST grade.
